args.evidence:
build_reference.py (line ~261) builds base_bank with a NAME-based rule: for each CAR_SND_CARn block in CARSOUND.DAT it reads :SOUNDBANK_TYPE CARn_SOUND_FILE and sets base_bank['CAR_SND_CARn'] = 'car' + SOUNDBANK_TYPE[3] + '_snd', i.e. CAR_SND_CAR6 + CAR6_SOUND_FILE -> 'car6_snd' (the digit is taken from the bank file name, not from the CAR_SND_CARn number). CARSOUND.DAT binds CAR_SND_CAR1..CAR_SND_CAR8 -> CAR1_SOUND_FILE..CAR8_SOUND_FILE (verified: 8 base blocks). The executable's static strings are 'sounds\car1_snd:0:0:5' ... 'sounds\car8_snd:7:35:5' (addresses 0x288e40..0x288f18) with templates '%s.msh' (0x28f508) and '%s.msb' (0x28f510); the trailing fields are base:offset:count with base 0..7, suggesting an index. Corroboration: 49_COUPE's sound type CAR_SND_49_COUPE inherits CAR_SND_CAR6 and its sample names are literally MASTER_SOUND_SAMPLE_CAR6_TICKOVER / ..._LOW_UNLOADED / ..._HIGH_LOADED, so the 'CAR6' identity appears in the sample data itself. All 35 cars resolve a chain; the 8 distinct inherit targets are CAR_SND_CAR1..CAR_SND_CAR8.
